standard-dialogue-after-the-ascent-of-ar.npc: You've done a great service to the people of Arceuus. Thank you.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-a-kin.player: Hello Asteros. What brings you to the castle?

standard-dialogue-after-completing-a-kin.npc: The King's late father asked for an advisor from Arceuus. He was keen for us to have a more central role than we did under the Council.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-a-kin.player: I see. I'm sure the King is glad to have you here.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-a-kin.npc: He does seem willing to take on my advice, which is very welcoming. I hope he remains humble. It is a trait many leaders lack.
Now, is there something else I can do for you? If you're interested, I can offer you the ability to respawn at Kourend Castle upon death.

steps.npc: Very well. From now on, you will respawn at Kourend Castle.
Let me know if you change your mind.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-a-kin.text: If the player lost A Dark Disposition:

steps.npc: Ah, I believe you are looking for this.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-a-kin.text: If player's current respawn point is not Kourend Castle:

steps.npc: Hello there. Would you like me to change your respawn point to Kourend Castle?

standard-dialogue-after-completing-a-kin.text: If player's current respawn point is Kourend Castle:

steps.npc: Hello there. Would you like me to revert your respawn point to Lumbridge?

steps.text: If the respawn point changes to Kourend Castle:

steps.npc: Very well. From now on, you will respawn at Kourend Castle.

steps.text: If the respawn point changes to Lumbridge:

steps.npc: Very well. From now on, you will respawn in Lumbridge.
